verdict.rationale: Stripe documents a Subscriptions API for creating subscriptions, proration previews that imply plan changes, an official MCP server that lets AI agents call the Stripe API, and an official CLI. Together these give agents a real programmatic surface for billing operations. However, nothing in the pack covers scoped or restricted permissions for agent access, or how to apply customer credits. Missing for 10: evidence of scoped or restricted API permissions for agents, documented credit-application operations, explicit plan-change API docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven billing.
